blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Evaluating open-ended text generation involves understanding how different properties of a continuation relate to its perceived quality. We present a reference-based framework for examining coherence and diversity through three perspectives: aligning their evolution with human trajectories, comparing their summaries with a human continuation of the same prompt, and estimating their likelihood under a human reference distribution. Experiments with human quality ratings suggest that diversity-based alignment and mean-based comparisons capture quality-related variation, although the comparisons do not establish a predictive advantage for temporal alignment over simpler baselines. Reference likelihood also shows positive associations with ratings, with results varying across reference configurations and scoring horizons. Together, these analyses provide a structured way to examine how measured coherence and diversity relate to human judgments, while distinguishing similarity to human references from quality itself. Code and analysis resources are available at https://github.com/EstebanGarces/likely_human .
blocks.zh: 评价可自由参加的文本生成,需要了解续作的不同性质如何与其预期的质量相关。 我们提出一个参照框架,通过三个方面来审查一致性和多样性:使其演变与人类轨迹相一致;将其摘要与人类延续的同一瞬间进行比较;在人类参考分布下估计其可能性。 具有人类质量评级的实验表明,基于多样性的调整和基于平均值的比较能够捕捉到与质量相关的差异,尽管这些比较并没有确定时间调整相对于较简单的基线的预测优势。 参考可能性还显示有评级的积极关联,结果因参考配置和评分前景而异。 这些分析一起提供了一种结构化的方法,用以审查衡量的一致性和多样性如何与人类的判断相联系,同时区分与人类参照的相似性与质量本身。 代码和分析资源见https://github.com/EstebanGarces/likely_human。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Evaluating open-ended text generation is difficult because many different continuations can be appropriate for the same prompt. Reference overlap alone cannot express the full range of valid outputs, and quality includes several dimensions that can conflict ( Gatt and Krahmer, 2018 ; Celikyilmaz et al., 2020 ; Howcroft et al., 2020 ) . A continuation may be fluent but repetitive, or lexically varied but inconsistent with its context. Coherence and diversity therefore provide useful, though incomplete, perspectives on the quality of generated text ( Hashimoto et al., 2019 ; Su et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 很难评价可自由使用的文本生成,因为许多不同的续作可以适合同样的即时. 仅靠参考重叠无法表达全部有效产出,质量包括几个可以冲突的维度(Gatt和Krahmer,2018;Celikyilmaz等人,2020;Howcroft等人,2020). 延续可能是流利但重复的,或从逻辑上讲是多种多样的,但与上下文不符。 因此,一致性和多样性对生成的文本的质量提供了有益但不完整的观点(Hashimoto等人,2019年;Su等人,2022年)。

blocks.en: Figure 1: How coherence (top) and diversity (bottom) evolve within human and machine continuations of the same prompt. Each curve follows one continuation as more of its text is evaluated. Higher coherence values indicate greater model predictability; higher diversity values indicate less n n -gram repetition. The framework compares these curves through alignment, summaries, and human reference distributions (Table 2 ).
blocks.zh: 图1:在同一瞬间的人和机器的延续中,一致性(顶部)和多样性(底部)是如何演变的。 每条曲线都沿着一条曲线继续,因为对其案文作了更多的评价。 更高的一致性值表示更高的模型可预测性;更高的多样性值表示较少n-gg重复. 该框架通过对齐、摘要和人类参考分布来比较这些曲线(表2)。

blocks.en: Figure 1 illustrates how coherence and diversity measurements evolve as successive prefixes of a continuation are evaluated. These trajectories offer a view of the text beyond its final score. They also raise a broader question: which aspects of the measurements are useful when comparing a generated continuation with human writing?
blocks.zh: 图1说明了一致性和多样性计量如何随着连续性连续前缀的评价而演变。 这些轨迹提供了超越最终得分的文本视角. 它们也提出了一个更广泛的问题:在比较生成的续作与人类的写作时,测量的哪些方面是有用的?

blocks.en: We examine this question through three analytical facets. Temporal alignment compares the shape of a trajectory with human trajectories. Summary comparison examines how its average values and variability differ from those of a human continuation of the same prompt. Reference-distribution likelihood assesses how typical a joint coherence–diversity profile is within a human corpus. These perspectives share measurements but use human references in different ways, allowing us to examine both sequential patterns and aggregate properties.
blocks.zh: 我们通过三个分析方面审查这一问题。 时间对齐将轨迹的形状与人类的轨迹进行比较. 简略比较研究了它的平均值和可变性与人类延续同一瞬间的价值和可变性有何不同。 参考分布可能性评估了共同一致性-多样性概况在人类体内的典型性。 这些观点分享了测量结果,但以不同的方式使用人类参考,使我们能够审查顺序模式和综合特性。

blocks.en: We use coherence and diversity as operational measures of model predictability and n n -gram non-repetition. They capture selected properties relevant to generation, while discourse coherence and semantic diversity remain broader concepts. Our experiments examine how the resulting scores relate to overall-quality ratings of English machine continuations.
blocks.zh: 我们使用一致性和多样性作为模型可预测性和n-g不重复的操作措施。 它们捕捉到与生成有关的某些属性,而语义一致性和语义多样性仍然是更广泛的概念。 我们的实验研究了结果的分数与英语机器续作的整体质量评级的关系.

blocks.en: Three research questions guide the analysis: 1. RQ1: Predictive information. How do temporal and prompt-relative summary scores relate to human ratings compared with simpler baselines? 2. RQ2: Length and references. How sensitive are those associations to reference selection, length normalization, and the number of scored tokens? 3. RQ3: Reference typicality. How does joint-profile likelihood relate to ratings, and how does that relationship depend on feature preparation and reference modeling?
blocks.zh: 指导分析的有三个研究问题: 1. RQ1:预测性信息。 与较简单的基线相比,时间和即时的汇总分数与人类的评级有何关系? 2. RQ2:长度和参考。 这些协会对参考选择、长度正常化和记分牌数量有多敏感? 3. RQ3:参考典型。 联合曝光的可能性与评级有何关系,这种关系如何取决于特征的编写和参考模型的建立?

blocks.zh: RQ1:预测信息. 与较简单的基线相比,时间和即时的汇总分数与人类的评级有何关系?

blocks.en: RQ2: Length and references. How sensitive are those associations to reference selection, length normalization, and the number of scored tokens?
blocks.zh: RQ2:长度和参考文献. 这些协会对参考选择、长度正常化和记分牌数量有多敏感?

blocks.en: RQ3: Reference typicality. How does joint-profile likelihood relate to ratings, and how does that relationship depend on feature preparation and reference modeling?

blocks.en: We contribute a framework that connects these three uses of human references, an empirical comparison with simple and established baselines, and sensitivity analyses of length and reference design. The experiments combine an analysis of archived full trajectories with controlled measurements at fixed token horizons. Together, they examine which relationships with human judgments persist across these choices and whether temporal comparison offers additional predictive information.
blocks.zh: 我们提供了一个框架,将人类参考的这三种用途联系起来,与简单和既定的基线进行实证比较,并对长度和参考设计进行敏感性分析。 这些实验将存档全轨分析与固定信使地平线的控制测量结合起来。 它们共同审查这些选择中与人类判断的哪些关系持续存在,以及时间比较是否提供额外的预测性信息。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: BLEU ( Papineni et al., 2002 ) , ROUGE ( Lin, 2004 ) , and METEOR ( Banerjee and Lavie, 2005 ) measure forms of lexical overlap. Their interpretation is limited when a prompt admits many acceptable continuations. Surveys emphasize both the diversity of evaluation criteria and the difficulty of relating automatic metrics to human judgments ( Novikova et al., 2017 ; Sai et al., 2022 ; Howcroft et al., 2020 ) . Our study focuses on the relationship between reference-based scores and overall-quality ratings of individual continuations.
blocks.zh: BLEU(Papineni等人,2002年),RoUGE(Lin,2004年)和METEOR(Banerjee和Lavie,2005年)衡量词汇重叠的形式。 当迅速承认许多可接受的延续时,解释是有限的。 调查强调评价标准的多样性以及将自动衡量标准与人类判断联系起来的困难(Novikova等人,2017年;Sai等人,2022年;Howcroft等人,2020年)。 我们的研究侧重于基于参考的分数与个人续作的整体质量评级之间的关系.

blocks.en: The tension between repetition and unpredictable output motivates contrastive search ( Su et al., 2022 ) , top- k k sampling ( Fan et al., 2018 ) , and nucleus sampling ( Holtzman et al., 2019 ) . Comparative work shows that decoding preferences depend on the setting ( Garces Arias et al., 2025c ) . Adaptive Contrastive Search ( Garces Arias et al., 2024 ) and GUARD ( Ding et al., 2025 ) use entropy signals over generation steps to adapt decoding. Min- k k Sampling uses local changes in sorted logits to determine truncation boundaries independently of temperature scaling ( Ding et al., 2026b ) . Variance-Calibrated Modulation reshapes the distribution before truncation through contextual token weighting and a logit-scale-aware repetition penalty ( Ding et al., 2026a ) . These methods modify generation, complementing our analysis of coherence and diversity in the resulting continuations.
blocks.zh: 重复与不可预测的输出之间的张力激发了对比性搜索(Su等人,2022年),顶端-kk采样(Fan等人,2018年),核取样(Holtzman等人,2019年). 比较工作显示,编码优惠取决于设置情况(Garces Arias等人,2025c)。 适应性对称性搜索(Garces Arias等人,2024年)和GUARD(Ding等人,2025年)在生成步骤上使用 en信号来适应解码. 敏 - 来 kk 采样在排序的对数中采用局部变化,以独立于温度缩放来确定调值边界(Ding等人,2026b ). 差异分解模块通过上下文符号加权和对数尺度-意识到重罚(Ding等人,2026a)在切换前重塑分布。 这些方法改变了生成方式,补充了我们对由此产生的延续过程的一致性和多样性的分析。

blocks.en: BERTScore ( Zhang et al., 2020 ) and BARTScore ( Yuan et al., 2021 ) use contextual representations or generation probabilities. MAUVE ( Pillutla et al., 2021 ) compares distributions of human and machine text. Q*Text ( Garces Arias et al., 2025b ) combines normalized coherence, diversity, and perplexity through weighted Gaussian penalties. We distinguish its fixed initialization from parameters optimized against human ratings. We report MAUVE at the corpus level and evaluate the other scores through continuation-level correlations, reflecting their different units of analysis. Discourse-oriented measures such as DiscoScore ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) , prompted evaluators such as G-Eval ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , and controlled diagnostic benchmarks such as OpenMEVA ( Guan et al., 2021 ) address complementary questions.
blocks.zh: BERTScore(张等,2020年)和BARTScore(袁等,2021年)使用背景表示或生成概率. MAUVE(Pillutla等人,2021年)比较人文文字和机器文字的分布. QQText(Garces Arias等人,2025年b)通过加权高斯罚款将正常化的一致性、多样性和复杂性结合起来。 我们把它的固定初始化和优化的参数 与人类的评级区分开来。 我们从实体层面报告MAUVE,并通过连续层面的关联来评价其他分数,反映它们不同的分析单位. DiscoScore(赵等人,2023年)等面向讨论的措施,促使G-Eval(刘等人,2023年)等评估人员,OpenMEVA(关等人,2021年)等控制性诊断基准解决了互补问题.

blocks.en: Generalized stochastic dominance compares decoding strategies across criteria and measurement scales ( Garces Arias et al., 2025a ) ; we examine continuation-level score correlations. Credal-set analysis compares human and model variation across multiple continuations ( Garces Arias et al., 2025d ) , whereas our diversity signal measures repetition within a continuation. Work on token exclusion under decoding distinguishes detectability from perceived quality ( Garces Arias et al., 2026 ) . Its quality analysis shares the rating collection used here and therefore provides related context rather than independent validation.
blocks.zh: 通用的条块式支配地位比较了各种标准和衡量尺度的编码战略(Garces Arias等人,2025a);我们审查了连续性等级的分数关系。 Credal-set分析比较了多种延续中的人类和模型差异(Garces Arias等人,2025d),而我们的多样性信号测量了延续中的重复。 解码下象征性排除的工作将可探测性与感知质量区分开来(Garces Arias等人,2026年)。 它的质量分析与这里使用的评分收集一致,因此提供了相关的上下文而不是独立的验证.

blocks.en: DTW aligns numerical sequences that evolve at different rates ( Sakoe and Chiba, 1978 ; Müller, 2007 ) . Applied here, DTW aligns numerical coherence and diversity trajectories. The resulting paths locate differences in those measurements; interpreting them in terms of entities or narrative events would require additional linguistic analysis. Soft-DTW ( Cuturi and Blondel, 2017 ) and explicit slope or change-point descriptors offer alternative temporal analyses; we use the DTW configuration specified in Section 4.1 .
blocks.zh: DTW对不同速率变化的数值序列进行比对(Sakoe和Chiba,1978年;Müller,2007年)。 在此应用, DTW 使数字一致性和多样性轨迹一致 。 由此产生的路径将确定这些计量的差异;从实体或叙述事件的角度加以解释,需要更多的语言分析。 软二维 (Cuturi and Blondel, 2017)和明确坡度或变点描述符提供了替代时间分析;我们使用第4.1节中规定的DTW配置.

blocks.en: 3.1 Prompts, Continuations, and Ratings
blocks.zh: 3.1 提示、延续和评级

blocks.en: A prompt is the fixed input text x x . A continuation is the complete subsequent text y = ( y 1 , … , y L ) y=(y_{1},\ldots,y_{L}) , written by a person or a model. A continuation prefix , y 1 : t y_{1:t} , is only its first t t evaluation tokens. A trajectory records measurements on successive prefixes of that same continuation. Each record therefore links the prompt and continuation to an ordered array of measurements.
blocks.zh: 提示是固定输入文本 x x 。 续作是完整的后续文本y=(y 1,.,y L)y=(y_{1},\ldots,y_{L}),由一个人或模型编写. 续作前缀 y 1 : t y _{1:t },只是它的第一个 t 评估符. 一个轨迹记录了同一续作的连续前缀的测量结果. 因此,每个记录都把迅速和持续与命令的一系列测量联系起来。

blocks.en: The continuations and human ratings come from prior work ( Garces Arias et al., 2025c ; Garces Arias et al., 2025a ) ; Table 1 records their settings. The prompts are expository, so the evaluation concerns open-ended continuation in that setting. Human texts supply references and are excluded from the main score–rating correlations. Prompt groups remain intact in uncertainty estimation.
blocks.zh: 续作和人类收视率来自之前的作品(Garces Arias等人,2025c;Garces Arias等人,2025a);表1记录了他们的设定. 这些提示是说明性的,因此,评价涉及在这种背景下无限期地继续下去。 人类文本提供了参考文献,被排除在主要得分关系之外。 在不确定性估计中,即时群体保持不变。

Continuation lengths vary substantially across methods; Appendix A reports their ranges and further agreement statistics.

blocks.en: 4 Three Analytical Facets
blocks.zh: 4个分析面

blocks.en: Table 2 summarizes how each facet uses the measurements and human references. Temporal alignment follows the progression of the measured signals through a continuation; summary comparison and likelihood examine their aggregate profiles. All three derive from cumulative prefix measurements and can therefore be affected by token order, although only temporal alignment explicitly matches positions across trajectories.
blocks.zh: 表2总结了每个面如何使用测量和人类参考. 时间调整是通过延续跟踪所测量信号的进展;简要比较和可能性检查其总体概况。 这三项都来源于累积前缀测量,因此可以受到令牌顺序的影响,虽然只有时间对齐才能明确匹配跨轨位置.

blocks.en: Table 2: Three ways to compare coherence and diversity with human references. Temporal alignment compares ordered measurements, summary comparison uses the human continuation of the same prompt, and likelihood describes the profile within a human corpus.

Within this paired setting, we also remove length normalization while leaving the references and DTW recurrence fixed. This isolates the effect of distance normalization within the paired-reference comparison.

blocks.en: An alignment path provides a way to inspect where measured trajectories differ. Its usefulness for explaining particular textual properties, such as repetition or topic shifts, remains an empirical question.

We therefore inspect the distributions and compare the full Gaussian with a diagonal-covariance Gaussian and a Gaussian-kernel density estimate using Scott’s bandwidth. The alternatives use the same reference records and features, without rating-based tuning. We also fit each reference domain separately to assess sensitivity to corpus composition.
blocks.zh: 它与质量的关系通过人类的评级来评估. 多样性是有限度的,差异是非负面的,而高斯人则无限制的支持。 因此,我们检查分布,并用斯科特带宽将整个高斯琴与对角-共变的高斯琴和高斯琴-内核密度估计进行比较。 替代品使用相同的参考记录和特征,不进行基于评级的调试。 我们还将每个参考领域分开,以评估对生物体构成的敏感性。

blocks.en: The archived likelihood comparisons remain exploratory because of the extraction limitations in Section 3.3 . The controlled experiment evaluates likelihood with consistent extraction across both corpora.
blocks.zh: 由于第3.3节中的提取限制,存档可能性比较仍然是探索性的。 受控实验以一致的提取方式评价两个蝎子的可能性.

blocks.en: 5 Evaluation Protocol and Baselines
blocks.zh: 5 评价议定书和基线

blocks.en: The full-trajectory comparisons use the same 250 machine texts and the mean of their two ratings. Fixed-horizon analyses use eligible subsets. We calculate Spearman’s rank correlation with average ranks for ties. Full-trajectory scores use the archived measurements described in Section 3.3 .
blocks.zh: 全轨比较使用相同的250台机器文本和他们两个收视率的平均值. 固定视距分析使用符合条件的子集. 我们计算斯皮尔曼的等级关系, 全轨分数使用第3.3节所述的存档测量.

blocks.en: We use 3,000 prompt-cluster bootstrap replicates, retaining all five machine outputs and their ratings within each sampled group. Sample-dependent score normalizations are refitted; human references and PCA loadings remain fixed. Intervals therefore condition on the reference resources and do not capture uncertainty from new annotators. Appendix A specifies the resampling and normalization details.
blocks.zh: 我们使用3 000个快速集群的靴子复制器,保留所有5个机器输出及其在每个抽样组中的评级。 依赖样品的分数正常化情况得到恢复;人类参考和五氯苯甲醚装载情况保持不变。 因此,相互间关系以参考资源为条件,不能反映新注释者的不确定性。 附 录 A具体规定了重新取样和正常化的细节。

blocks.en: We report percentile 95% intervals for individual correlations and for paired differences calculated within the same replicate. A paired interval containing zero leaves the direction of the difference unresolved; it is not evidence of equivalence. The ablations are exploratory and their intervals are not adjusted for testing multiple alternatives. We additionally report correlations against each annotator to reveal dependence on the rating source.
blocks.zh: 我们报告95%的间隔 用于个人的关联 以及在同一复制中计算出来的配对差异。 包含0的对接间隔留下了差异方向未解决;它不是等效的证据. 涂料是探索性的,没有调整间隔以测试多种替代品。 我们还报告与每个注释者的相关性,以揭示对评级来源的依赖。

blocks.en: For RQ1, we compare temporal and summary scores with simpler and established baselines. For RQ2, we vary references and normalization, then evaluate fixed token horizons. For RQ3, we examine reference preparation and density models using archived and controlled measurements. All analyses use full-text ratings; Appendices D and E give implementation details.
blocks.zh: 就RQ1而言,我们比较时间和总结分数与更简单和确定的基线。 对RQ2来说,我们有不同的参考和正常化,然后评估固定的象征前景。 关于RQ3,我们使用存档和控制的测量方法审查参考编制和密度模型。 所有分析都采用全文评级;附录D和E提供执行细节。

blocks.en: The final cached coherence and diversity values provide endpoint baselines. The trajectory mean and variance of each signal help assess whether aggregate properties capture similar associations to temporal comparison. These baselines require no human reference trajectory at scoring time.
blocks.zh: 最后的缓存一致性和多样性值提供了终点基线。 每个信号的轨迹平均值和差异有助于评估总属性是否捕捉到与时间比较相似的关联. 这些基线在评分时不需要人的参考轨迹。

blocks.en: PCA provides an unsupervised combination of trajectory means and variances. We retain the released fit on all 300 texts and evaluate its fixed components on the 250 machines; component signs are arbitrary. Fixed Q*Text applies the published, untuned initialization to cached endpoint perplexity, coherence, and diversity ( Garces Arias et al., 2025b ) . Its normalization and exact formula are given in Appendix B . Neither baseline is fitted to the quality ratings in this comparison.
blocks.zh: 五氯苯甲醚提供了轨迹手段和差异的无监督结合。 我们保留了所有300个文本的发包,并在250台机器上评估其固定部件;部件标志是任意的。 固定QQText将已公布的,未调试的初始化应用到缓存端点的模糊性,一致性和多样性(Garces Arias等人,2025b ). 它的正常化和确切公式载于附录B。 在这个比较中,两个基准都不符合质量评级。

blocks.en: We report the original MAUVE results descriptively because they compare whole text distributions, whereas our primary analysis evaluates individual continuations. MAUVE supplies one corpus-level value for each decoding strategy. Appendix B documents their inputs and settings.
blocks.zh: 我们以描述方式报告最初的MAUVE结果,因为它们比较了整个文本分布,而我们的主要分析则评价了个别的续作. MAUVE为每个解码策略提供一个实体级值. 附 录 B 记录他们的输入和设置。

blocks.zh: 6 结果

blocks.en: 6.2 RQ1: Baselines and Annotator Sensitivity
blocks.zh: 6.2 RQ1:基线和注释敏感性

blocks.en: Fixed Q*Text reaches ρ = 0.612 \rho=0.612 ( [ 0.510 , 0.677 ] [0.510,0.677] ), the largest positive point estimate among the primary scores in Table 3 . Its parameters use the published initialization without fitting to these ratings. The paired difference for diversity DTW minus fixed Q*Text is − 0.076 -0.076 ( [ − 0.141 , 0.021 ] [-0.141,0.021] ), which does not resolve their ordering.

blocks.en: The PCA results in Table 3 provide further context: the magnitude of PC2’s association is similar to that of diversity DTW. Its arbitrary orientation and unsupervised objective, however, differ from a quality-calibrated score.
blocks.zh: 表3中的常设仲裁法院结果提供了进一步的背景:PC2的关联程度与多样性的DTW相似。 然而,它的任意定向和不受监督的目标与质量校准的分数不同。

blocks.en: Table 8 shows that associations also vary by annotator. For example, the summary mean composite correlates 0.554 and 0.300 with the two raters, while diversity DTW correlates 0.507 and 0.436. These differences suggest caution when interpreting agreement with the average rating as a stable preference. Agreement between raters provides context for this variability, although it does not set a numerical ceiling on correlation with their average.
blocks.zh: 表8显示,协会也因注释者而异。 例如,汇总表示的复合材料与两种计量标准相关联0.554和0.300,而多样性DTW则与0.507和0.436相关联。 这些差异表明,在将与平均评级一致解释为一种稳定的偏好时要谨慎。 评级人之间的协议为这种可变性提供了背景,尽管它没有设定与平均值相关联的数值上限。

blocks.en: Corpus-level MAUVE ranks temperature sampling first (0.3207), followed by beam search (0.1006), contrastive search (0.0921), top- k k (0.0524), and top- p p (0.0225). These distributions do not reproduce the order of average human quality ratings: top- p p has the highest machine rating, 2.69, and beam search the lowest, 2.00. With 50 texts per distribution, this comparison offers limited descriptive context for how corpus similarity and individual quality judgments may differ.
blocks.zh: Corpus-level MAUVE将温度取样排在首位(0.3207),其次是光束搜索(0.106),对比性搜索(0.0921),顶端-k k(0.0524)和顶端-p(0.0225). 这些发行不转载人类平均质量评级的顺序:上-p拥有最高的机器评级2.69,梁搜索最低的2.00. 这种比较每次分发50个文本,对实体相似性和个人质量判断可能有所不同的描述范围有限。

blocks.en: 6.3 RQ2: Length and Reference Ablations
blocks.zh: 6.3 RQ2: 长度和参考量

blocks.en: Table 4: Length and reference ablations. Paired means one human reference for the same prompt. Raw DTW omits length normalization.
blocks.zh: 表4:长度和参考时间。 Paired指同一瞬间的人性参考. 原始 DTW 省略长度常态 。

blocks.en: Table 4 addresses RQ2 by varying reference selection and normalization. Using only the human trajectory for the same prompt gives a diversity DTW correlation of 0.512. Removing length normalization from this same paired-reference procedure lowers the observed correlation to 0.436. The paired difference is 0.076 ( [ 0.044 , 0.108 ] [0.044,0.108] ), supporting length normalization for this particular diversity comparison. Its scope is the paired diversity comparison evaluated here.
blocks.zh: 表4通过不同的参考选择和正常化处理RQ2。 仅使用人类的轨迹进行同一提示,则DTW的多样化相关性为0.512。 从同一个对齐参照程序中取消长度正常化,将观察到的关联性降低到0.436。 配对的差值为0.076([0.044,0.108] [0.044,0.108]),支持这一特殊多样性比较的长度正常化. 其范围是本文评价的组合多样性比较。

blocks.en: For coherence, the paired-reference normalized score reaches 0.254, compared with 0.181 without normalization and 0.146 for the all-reference score. The two signals show different patterns across reference choices, suggesting that the usefulness of a matched reference may depend on the measured property.

blocks.en: The unweighted summary mean composite reaches 0.482, compared with 0.527 after division by machine length. The paired difference is 0.044 ( [ − 0.075 , 0.183 ] [-0.075,0.183] ), which does not resolve an advantage from that weighting.

blocks.en: 6.4 RQ2: Controlled Token Horizons
blocks.zh: 6.4 RQ2: 受控托肯地平线

blocks.en: Table 5: Associations with full-text quality ratings when all scored continuations have a common token horizon. Values are Spearman correlations with 95% prompt-cluster bootstrap intervals. Each column uses the eligible texts and references for that horizon; the paired comparison in Appendix E holds membership constant.
blocks.zh: 表5:在所有得分续作都具有共同符号视野时具有全文质量评级的社团. 值是Spearman与95%的快速集群靴子间隔的关联. 每个栏目都使用该视野的合格文本和参考文献;附录E中的配对比较保持不变。

blocks.en: To examine the associations at a common scored length, we measure coherence and diversity using the same OPT-2.7B configuration for both corpora. We evaluate the first 64 and 128 continuation tokens in separate analyses, without padding shorter texts. We retain complete prompt groups and refit the human reference models at each horizon; Table 1 reports the eligible collections.
blocks.zh: 为了以共同的评分长度来审查这些协会,我们用两个公司相同的PALP-2.7B配置来衡量一致性和多样性。 我们分别对头64个和128个延续符号进行了评估,没有添加较短的文本。 我们保留了完整的即时小组,并在每一地平线上重新使用人类参考模型; 表1报告了合格的收集情况。

blocks.en: Table 5 reports positive diversity-DTW and variance-profile likelihood associations at both horizons. Adjusting for original continuation and prompt lengths retains positive associations. Separately adjusting score and rating ranks for decoding strategy also retains positive associations for both scores, whereas coherence-DTW intervals include zero at both horizons (Appendix E , Table 10 ). This suggests that these associations are not explained solely by the between-method differences captured by the rank adjustment.
blocks.zh: 表5显示,在这两个领域都存在积极的多样性和差异性可能性关联。 调整原先的延续和迅速的长度,保留了积极的关联。 单独调整解码策略的分数和分数排名也保留了两个分数的正联,而一致性-DTW间隔包含两个地平线上的0(附录E,表10). 这表明,这些协会并非完全以军衔调整所体现的方法差异来解释。

blocks.en: On the same texts and reference bank, increasing the horizon from 64 to 128 changes the variance-profile correlation by 0.139 ( [ 0.019 , 0.261 ] [0.019,0.261] ). The associations remain sensitive to horizon, and ratings concern whole texts rather than isolated prefixes. Neither horizon establishes a diversity-DTW advantage over endpoint diversity. Appendix E provides extraction details, adjustment definitions, and paired comparisons.
blocks.zh: 在同一文本和参考库中,视线从64个增加到128个,使差异预测的关联性变化0.139([0.019,0.261][0.019,0.261])。 协会对视野仍然敏感,评级涉及全文而不是孤立的前缀。 两者都未确立多样性-DTW优于终点多样性。 附 录 E提供了提取细节,调整定义,以及配对比较.

blocks.en: Figure 3: How diversity alignment (left) and the mean summary composite (right) relate to human quality ratings. Each point represents a machine continuation, colored by decoding strategy; some points overlap. The spread illustrates variation both within and between strategies.

blocks.en: 6.5 RQ3: Reference-Distribution Likelihood
blocks.zh: 6.5 RQ3:参考-分发可能性

blocks.en: Reference likelihood also associates with ratings in the archived analysis (Table 9 ). The mean-profile Gaussian has a correlation of 0.409 and the variance-profile Gaussian reaches 0.598. These findings are conditional on the cache reconstruction and extraction limitations described in Section 3.3 .
blocks.zh: 参考可能性也与存档分析中的评级相关(表9)。 中标的高斯人的相关比例为0.409,差异的高斯人的相关比例达到0.598. 这些调查结果以第3.3节所述的缓存重建和提取限制为条件。

blocks.en: Diagonal Gaussian and Gaussian-kernel estimates also yield positive associations (Table 9 ). Domain-specific fits show further variation (Appendix C ). These comparisons do not identify a preferred distribution or domain on held-out data. The quantile plots in Figure 5 indicate departures from marginal normality; neither Gaussian nor Gaussian-kernel fits enforce the bounded support of diversity.

blocks.en: For RQ3, the comparisons suggest that the strength of the likelihood association varies with reference preparation and modeling choices. The positive variance-profile associations in the shared-pipeline experiment (Section 6.4 ) indicate that such an association also occurs with consistent extraction, although its magnitude depends on horizon. Their potential use in a new domain would need evaluation against that domain’s texts and quality criteria. Figures 7 and 8 compare the controlled mean-profile distributions by decoding method with the fitted human reference.
blocks.zh: 就RQ3而言,比较表明,可能性关联的强度随参考材料编制和模型选择而不同。 共享管实验中呈现正差异的关联(第6.4节)表明,这种关联也不断发生,尽管其规模取决于地平线。 需要根据新领域的案文和质量标准来评价其在新领域的潜在用途。 图7和图8通过解码法将可控平均分布与适当的人类参考数据进行比较。

blocks.en: 7 Discussion and Practical Use
blocks.zh: 7 讨论和实际使用

blocks.en: The three facets offer different ways to relate generated text to human writing. Temporal alignment follows the evolution of the measured signals, summary comparison uses a human continuation of the same prompt, and likelihood places the joint profile within a broader human reference. The baseline comparisons assess how these different reference questions relate to quality prediction.
blocks.zh: 这三个方面提供了将生成的文本与人类书写联系起来的不同方式。 时间调和随所测信号的演化而来,简略比较使用同一即时的人类续作,并有可能将联合剖面置于更广泛的人类参考. 基线比较评估了这些不同的参考问题与质量预测的关系。

blocks.en: Across the experiments, diversity alignment and mean-based comparisons show positive associations with human judgments, while endpoint diversity also captures substantial variation in ratings. The paired comparisons leave a predictive advantage for DTW unresolved. An alignment may nevertheless be useful for examining where measured trajectories diverge. Establishing a connection between those differences and recognizable textual problems would require direct tests, for example with controlled repetition or topic shifts. Such perturbations can probe behavior beyond score–rating correlation ( He et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 在整个实验中,多样性的一致和基于平均值的比较显示出与人类判断的积极关联,而端点多样性也反映出评级方面的巨大差异。 配对比较为DTW未解决留下了预测优势. 然而,调整或许有助于审查所计量的轨迹存在差异之处。 确定这些差异与可识别的文字问题之间的联系需要直接检验,例如,有控制的重复或专题转移。 这种扰动可以探究超越得分关系的行为(He等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: Reference likelihood adds a distributional perspective. The variance-profile associations in the controlled experiment suggest that typicality can carry quality-related information, although the strength of that relationship varies with the scoring horizon. An unusual profile may also reflect an appropriate but uncommon continuation. Applications such as filtering would therefore need evidence about which kinds of atypical text should be retained, as well as validation of the reference model in the intended domain.
blocks.zh: 参考可能性增加了分布视角. 受控实验中差异性关联表明,典型性可以携带与质量有关的信息,尽管这种关系的强度随评分水平而异. 不同寻常的概况也可能反映适当但不寻常的延续。 因此,过滤等应用需要证明哪些类型的非典型文本应予保留,以及在预期领域验证参考模型。

blocks.en: Practical use also depends on the available references. Summary comparison needs a human continuation of the same prompt; temporal alignment and likelihood use human reference collections. Endpoint scores and fixed composites offer simpler alternatives when such resources are unavailable. Temporal alignment also has greater downstream computational cost than summary comparison or Gaussian scoring (Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: 实际使用还取决于现有的参考文献。 简略比较需要人类继续同样的即时;时间调整和可能性使用人类参考文献。 终点分数和固定复合材料在缺乏这些资源时提供了更简单的替代办法。 与简要比较或高斯积分(附录A)相比,时间调和还具有更大的下游计算成本。

blocks.en: The overall-quality judgments leave open which textual properties drive the associations. More targeted annotation could help connect the numerical patterns to readers’ assessments of coherence and diversity.
blocks.zh: 总体质量判断没有打开哪些文字属性能推动协会的发展。 更有针对性的说明有助于将数字模式与读者对一致性和多样性的评估联系起来。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We presented a reference-based framework for analyzing coherence and diversity in open-ended text generation through temporal alignment, comparison with matched human continuations, and likelihood under human reference distributions. The experiments suggest that diversity-based alignment and mean-based comparisons capture variation associated with human quality judgments. Positive associations also occur for reference likelihood, although their strength varies with the reference configuration and the portion of text evaluated. The comparisons with simpler baselines leave the predictive advantage of temporal alignment uncertain. The framework brings these findings together while making explicit the different questions that human references can support. Further work could examine whether the observed patterns correspond to recognizable textual properties, such as repetition or topic shifts, and whether these relationships extend to other generation settings.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个参考框架,通过时间调整、与匹配的人类延续和人类参考分布下的可能性进行比较,分析可自由参加的文本生成的一致性和多样性。 这些实验表明,基于多样性的对齐和基于中位数的比较能够捕捉到与人类质量判断相关的差异。 积极关联也存在参考可能性,尽管其强度因参考配置和所评价的文本部分而异。 与较简单的基线的比较使得时间调整的预测优势不确定。 该框架将这些结论汇集在一起,同时明确了人类参考资料可以支持的不同问题。 进一步的工作可以审查所观察到的形态是否与可识别的文字性质相对应,例如重复或专题转移,以及这些关系是否延伸到其他代代环境。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: The evaluation covers a small English sample from one generator and fixed decoding configurations. Two annotators provide overall-quality ratings with limited agreement, leaving generalization and dimension-specific judgments open to further study. Further, Gaussian support extends beyond the feature bounds, and neither Gaussian nor KDE scores are calibrated quality probabilities. Bootstrap intervals condition on fixed references and PCA loadings; exploratory comparisons lack multiplicity adjustment. Strategy-adjusted associations remain descriptive rather than causal.
blocks.zh: 评价涵盖一个发电机和固定解码配置的英文样本。 两名注释员以有限的一致意见提供总体质量评级,使一般化和特定层面的判断可供进一步研究。 另外,高斯的支持也超越了特性界限,高斯和 KDE 的分数都不是校准质量概率的. 固定参照物和五氯苯甲醚装载的靴子间隔条件;探索性比较缺乏多重调整。 战略调整后的协会仍然是描述性的,而不是因果性的。

blocks.en: Finally, the measurements represent model predictability and lexical repetition, offering limited coverage of discourse coherence, creativity, factuality, or safety. Broader evaluation would require alternative assessor models, independent ratings, held-out settings, and controlled textual perturbations.
blocks.zh: 最后,衡量标准代表了模式的可预测性和词汇重复,对讨论的一致性、创造性、事实性或安全性提供了有限的覆盖面。 更广泛的评价需要替代的评估师模型、独立评级、搁置设置和受控制的文字干扰。

blocks.en: Appendix D Feature Preparation and Sensitivity
blocks.zh: 附录D 特征准备和敏感性

blocks.en: For each primary text, the stored coherence array has L L values and the diversity array has L − 1 L-1 . All per-text means and population variances used below are recomputed over the actual stored arrays; they match the released summary columns to numerical precision. The coherence length L L is the denominator in the summary normalization. DTW uses each signal’s own array length. We do not pad one array to match another.
blocks.zh: 对于每个主文本,存储的一致数组有L L值,多样性数组有L−1 L-1. 下文使用的所有文字手段和总数差异均对实际储存的数组进行重新计算;它们将释放的概要列与数字精度相匹配。 一致性长度LL是即时正常化的分母. DTW使用每个信号自己的阵列长度. 我们不设置一个阵列来匹配另一个阵列。

blocks.en: The extended cache requires separate preparation. Its coherence arrays contain token log probabilities, and its saved summary values are rounded to two decimal places. We form cumulative averages of the stored log probabilities before calculating trajectory means and population variances, and recompute diversity summaries from the stored arrays. This avoids treating rounded zero variances as evidence of constant trajectories. The underlying arrays remain rounded, and the primary and reference extraction pipelines are not fully documented. We therefore interpret the reconstructed likelihood results as exploratory evidence about the association between reference typicality and ratings. The sensitivity comparisons below assess the consequences for the fitted scores.
blocks.zh: 扩展缓存需要单独准备. 其一致性数组包含符号日志概率,其保存的汇总值四舍五入为小数点后两个位数. 在计算轨迹手段和数量差异之前,我们形成所储存的日志概率的累积平均值,并从所储存的数组中重新计算多样性摘要。 这避免了将四舍五入的零差异作为恒定轨迹的证据. 基础阵列仍为四舍五入,主要和参考提取管道没有完整的文件记录. 因此,我们把重建的可能性结果解释为关于参考典型与评级之间关联的探索性证据。 下文的敏感性比较评估了相应分数的后果。

blocks.en: As an exploratory alternative, we calculate the negative Euclidean distance from a text’s two-dimensional summary to the reconstructed corpus mean. Unlike the prompt-relative composite, this alternative changes the reference, coordinate scaling, and aggregation together. Its performance cannot isolate the benefit of prompt-specific references.
blocks.zh: 作为探索性选择,我们计算出从文本的二维摘要到重建体的负欧几利得距离。 与即时相对的复合体不同的是,这种替代方法改变了参考、协调缩放和聚合。 其业绩不能孤立迅速具体提及的好处。

blocks.en: The extended summary CSV contains two-decimal summaries. In particular, small nonzero diversity variances may be stored as zero. The supplied variance-reference parameters were fitted to 1,156 records with positive stored diversity variance. Such selection changes the modeled population: it is a distribution conditional on crossing a rounding threshold, rather than a reference for all human records. The reconstruction calculates variances from the available arrays and retains genuine zero-variance trajectories.
blocks.zh: 扩展摘要CSV包含二进制摘要. 特别是,小的非零多样性差异可能为零。 所提供的差异参考参数符合1 156份记录,并有正数存储的多样性差异。 这种选择改变了模式人口:这种分配是以跨越四舍五入门槛为条件的,而不是所有人类记录的参考。 重建计算出与可用数组的差异,并保留真正的零变轨.

blocks.en: On the common 250-machine subset, applying the supplied summary-based Gaussian parameters gives correlations of 0.458 for means and 0.257 for variances. The reconstructed, overlap-excluded fits give 0.409 and 0.598. This comparison describes sensitivity to data preparation on the same evaluation sample. The summary-based and array-based configurations differ in multiple ways, so the comparison does not isolate a single cause.
blocks.zh: 在常见的250机子集上,应用所提供的汇总式高斯语参数给出了0.458与0.257之间的相关关系。 重建的,排除重叠的配位给予0.409和0.598. 这一比较说明了对同一评价样本上的数据编制工作的敏感性。 基于摘要的和基于数组的配置有多种不同,因此比较不会孤立一个单一的原因.

blocks.en: All primary temporal coefficients are recomputed as Spearman correlations. On the same 250-machine subset, the negative Euclidean mean-profile score has ρ = 0.165 \rho=0.165 and its variance counterpart has ρ = 0.019 \rho=0.019 . These scores use the reconstructed corpus means, retain the raw coordinate scales, and change several design choices relative to the prompt-relative composite. Their weaker observed associations do not isolate reference selection as the cause. These cached continuation-level comparisons use the same 250 machines; the controlled prefix experiment uses the eligible subsets in Appendix E . Corpus-level MAUVE remains a separate descriptive analysis.
blocks.zh: 所有初级时间系数都重算为斯皮尔曼相关系数. 在同一250机子集上,负欧几里得分的欧几里得分为±0.165\rho=0.165,其差异对应的欧几里得分为±0.019\rho=0.019. 这些分数使用重建的命题手段,保留原始坐标尺度,并相对于即时相对复合体改变若干设计选择. 它们观测到的较弱的关联并不将参考选择孤立为原因。 这些缓存的继续级比较使用相同的250台机器;受控前缀实验使用附录E中的合格子集. 公司一级的MAUVE仍然是单独的描述性分析.

blocks.zh: 附录E 长度控制和地平线敏感性

blocks.en: We score all 300 primary and 10,000 reference texts using OPT-2.7B, model/tokenizer revision 905a4b6 , in float32 with TF32 disabled. Prompt and continuation whitespace is stripped separately; each is tokenized separately without special tokens, and exactly one BOS token is prepended. We score at most the first 128 continuation tokens, conditioned on the prompt. All prompts have at most 81 tokens, so these measurements fit within the 2,048-token context. Coherence is the cumulative mean of next-token log probabilities. Diversity is the product of distinct-to-total token-ID n n -gram ratios for n = 2 , 3 , 4 n=2,3,4 , with ratios set to one before enough tokens exist. Both signals include the first continuation token and use identical positions. Per-text variances use divisor T T . Validation compared token IDs, lengths, and hashes with the source texts and recomputed summary features from the stored trajectories. Cross-entropy and block-partition checks verified the consistency of the GPU calculations. Full model and tokenizer identifiers, software versions, and validation results accompany the analysis.
blocks.zh: 我们使用OPT-2.7B、型号/推算器订正版905a4b6,在浮标32中获得300份初级文本和10,000份参考文本,TF32已停用。 即时和续作的白空被单独剥离;每个白空被单独标注,没有特别的代号,并且正准备一个BOS代号. 我们得分最多是前128个续作符号,条件是要及时. 所有提示最多有81个符号,所以这些测量值符合2,048个托肯上下文. 一致性是下个托肯日志概率的累积平均值. 多样性是n = 2、3、4 n = 2、3、4 = 2、3、4 的明显与总的代号-ID n-gram比率的产物,在足够代号存在之前,将比率设定为1。 两种信号都包含第一个续发符,并使用相同的位置. 文字差异使用divisor T T T. 校验将代号ID,长度,散列与源文本和存储轨迹的重制摘要特征进行比较. 交叉切换和块分割检查验证了GPU计算的一致性. 分析附有完整的模型和标识器标识符、软件版本和验证结果。

blocks.en: Horizons 64 and 128 were selected from cached length coverage before the controlled measurements, without optimizing against ratings; this is not a preregistered design. Table 5 summarizes the resulting associations. Only complete six-text prompt groups with at least T T tokens in every continuation are retained. This gives 40 groups (200 machines) at 64 and 23 groups (115 machines) at 128. No sequence is padded. The DTW human bank contains the corresponding 40 or 23 humans; distances use symmetric2 absolute-cost alignment divided by T T . Gaussian fits use 7,686 and 7,149 eligible human-corpus records after excluding 48 exact overlaps with primary human references. Both reference and evaluated summaries use the same horizon and extraction. The controlled extraction includes the 75 texts without archived feature arrays. Eligibility alters domain composition: no ROCStories records qualify at 128.
blocks.zh: 地平线64和128是从控制测量之前的缓存长度范围中选择的,没有根据评级进行优化;这不是预先注册的设计. 表5概述了由此产生的协会。 只保留每次续作中至少有 T T 令牌的完整六文本提示组. 这样,64组有40组(200台机器),128组有23组(115台机器)。 没有序列是加的。 DTW人类库包含相应的40或23个人类;距离使用对称2绝对成本对齐除以T T. 高斯安在排除了48个与主要人类参考文献的精确重叠后,恰好使用了7,686和7,149个合格的人类公司记录. 参考摘要和评估摘要都使用同样的视野和提取。 控制提取包括没有存档特性阵列的75个文本. 资格改变域组成:没有ROC Stories记录有资格达到128.

blocks.en: Intervals use 3,000 prompt-cluster bootstrap replicates (seed 20260907), retaining all five machine methods per sampled prompt and conditioning on fixed reference banks. Summary standardization is refitted in each replicate. For rank-residual sensitivity, both score and rating ranks are residualized against an intercept and cubic polynomials of centered empirical ranks of original machine continuation length, matched-human continuation length, and prompt length. Ranks and regressions are refitted per replicate. These are descriptive residual associations, not ordinary Spearman coefficients or causal effects. The adjusted diversity-DTW and Gaussian variance-profile coefficients are 0.336 and 0.286 at 64 tokens, and 0.439 and 0.493 at 128.
blocks.zh: Intervals使用3000个快速集群的靴子复制(种子20260907),保留每个取样的快速和固定参考库上的所有五个机器方法。 每次复制都要重新进行简易标准化。 对于留级灵敏度,分数和分数的分数均在原机连续长度,匹配人续长度,以及即时长度等中枢经验级的截击和立方多音分中留级. 排名和回归每复制一次都会重排. 这些是描述性的残余关联,而不是普通的斯皮尔曼系数或因果关系. 调整后的多样性-DTW和高斯差异分布系数为0.336和0.286,64符号为0.439和0.493。

blocks.en: To isolate horizon changes from changes in cohort and reference membership, we additionally score 64-token prefixes on the 128-eligible set: the same 115 machines, 23 primary humans, and 7,149 corpus references. Gaussian parameters are refitted at each horizon on those same records. The paired 128-minus-64 changes are 0.121 ( [ − 0.036 , 0.290 ] [-0.036,0.290] ) for diversity DTW, 0.066 ( [ − 0.008 , 0.137 ] [-0.008,0.137] ) for Gaussian means, and 0.139 ( [ 0.019 , 0.261 ] [0.019,0.261] ) for Gaussian variances. These intervals are not multiplicity-adjusted. blocks.en: Table 10 reports an exploratory adjustment applied to all six scores in Table 5 . We rank scores and ratings over each eligible cohort using average ranks for ties, regress each rank vector on five decoding-method indicators, and correlate the residuals. This removes method-specific mean ranks; it is neither an average of within-method Spearman correlations nor a causal adjustment. Each of 3,000 prompt-cluster bootstrap replicates (seed 20260908) refits summary standardization, ranks, and regressions, with reference banks fixed. Intervals are pointwise and not multiplicity-adjusted. This analysis controls decoding strategy separately from the length adjustment above, rather than estimating a joint adjustment. Diversity DTW, variance-profile likelihood, endpoint diversity, and the mean summary retain positive residual associations at both horizons. Coherence DTW has intervals spanning zero at both horizons, and mean-profile likelihood at 64 tokens also has an interval spanning zero. The adjustment thus leaves different patterns of association across the measured signals and facets.
blocks.zh: 表10报告对表5中所有六个分数进行了探索性调整。 我们对每个符合条件的群体进行分数和评分,使用平均的等级关系,在5个解码方法指标上递归每个等级矢量,并将剩余因素联系起来。 这消除了方法上特有的平均排名;既不是方法内Spearman关联的平均值,也不是因果调整. 每3 000个快速集群靴子复制(见20260908种子)重新适应简易标准化、等级和回归,并固定参考库。 间距是尖端的,不是多重调整的。 这一分析控制了与上述长度调整分开的解码策略,而不是估计联合调整. 多样性 DTW, 差异可视可能性,端点多样性,以及平均值在这两个视野中都保留了积极的剩余关联. 一致性 DTW 两个视野的间隔为0,64个符号的平均值概率也为0。 因此,这一调整在所测量的信号和方面留下了不同的联系模式。

blocks.en: Equal token horizons hold the number of scored continuation tokens constant within each analysis. Content differences and other length-related influences may remain, and the results can vary with the horizon. The ratings describe entire continuations, so prefix scores are not validated against prefix-specific judgments. The prefix-only run does not provide full-length scores beyond 128 tokens. Eligibility restricts the texts represented in these results. The Gaussian scores describe typicality under the fitted model, with their relationship to quality evaluated through correlation.
blocks.zh: 等值的符号视野在每次分析中都保持得分的续作符号数不变. 内容差异和其他与长度有关的影响可能依然存在,其结果随地平线而变化。 收视率描述的是整个续作,因此前缀分数不针对前缀特定判断进行验证. 前缀只运行不会提供超过128个符的全长分数. 资格限制这些结果所体现的案文。 高斯得分在配装模型下描述典型性,其与质量的关系通过关联性评价.

blocks.en: The beam panel illustrates that group differences can involve both location and spread. At 128 tokens, its observed mean-diversity values span a visibly broader range than those of the matched humans. This is descriptive evidence about these measured profiles, not a test that one strategy produces better text. The gray region above diversity one makes a limitation of the Gaussian approximation explicit: its contours can extend beyond the signal’s possible range. The mean-profile views do not establish the fit or validity of the separate variance-profile likelihood model.
